title: 模糊坐标
summary: 去掉坐标中的逗号、小数点和空格后得到一串数字，枚举所有符合数字书写规则的原坐标。
insight: 枚举横纵坐标切分点；每一段独立生成所有合法整数或小数形式，再做笛卡尔积。
pitfalls: 多位整数不能有前导零
以零开头的多位段只能写成 0.xxx

solutions.title: 切分并生成合法数字形式
solutions.idea: 分别枚举两段数字的所有合法表示。
steps: 去掉外层括号，枚举 split=1..length-1
forms(part) 加入合法整数，并枚举每个小数点位置，检查整数部分无前导零且小数部分无尾零
组合左右 forms 为 (left, right)

code.java: class Solution { public List<String> ambiguousCoordinates(String s){String digits=s.substring(1,s.length()-1);List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int split=1;split<digits.length();split++)for(String left:forms(digits.substring(0,split)))for(String right:forms(digits.substring(split)))answer.add("("+left+", "+right+")");return answer;}private List<String> forms(String part){List<String> result=new ArrayList<>();if(part.length()==1||part.charAt(0)!='0')result.add(part);for(int dot=1;dot<part.length();dot++){String integer=part.substring(0,dot),fraction=part.substring(dot);if((integer.length()==1||integer.charAt(0)!='0')&&fraction.charAt(fraction.length()-1)!='0')result.add(integer+"."+fraction);}return result;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun ambiguousCoordinates(s:String):List<String>{val digits=s.substring(1,s.length-1);val answer=mutableListOf<String>();for(split in 1 until digits.length)for(left in forms(digits.substring(0,split)))for(right in forms(digits.substring(split)))answer.add("($left, $right)");return answer};private fun forms(part:String):List<String>{val result=mutableListOf<String>();if(part.length==1||part[0]!='0')result.add(part);for(dot in 1 until part.length){val integer=part.substring(0,dot);val fraction=part.substring(dot);if((integer.length==1||integer[0]!='0')&&fraction.last()!='0')result.add("$integer.$fraction")};return result} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<string> forms(string part){vector<string> result;if(part.size()==1||part[0]!='0')result.push_back(part);for(int dot=1;dot<(int)part.size();++dot){string integer=part.substr(0,dot),fraction=part.substr(dot);if((integer.size()==1||integer[0]!='0')&&fraction.back()!='0')result.push_back(integer+"."+fraction);}return result;}public:vector<string> ambiguousCoordinates(string s){string digits=s.substr(1,s.size()-2);vector<string> answer;for(int split=1;split<(int)digits.size();++split)for(string left:forms(digits.substr(0,split)))for(string right:forms(digits.substr(split)))answer.push_back("("+left+", "+right+")");return answer;} };
